tooltip.nirncraft.guide.handbook: Everything a newcomer to Skyrim should know. Use it to read.
guide.nirncraft.title: The Traveler's Handbook
guide.nirncraft.subtitle: Being a plain guide to Skyrim and the lands of Nirn, for those newly arrived
guide.nirncraft.how_to_read: Turn pages with the arrows, A and D, or the mouse wheel. Click a chapter to open it.
guide.nirncraft.hints.off: Tutorial hints are off. Type /handbook hints on to bring them back.
You begin as a nobody: someone who wakes in a cottage above Helgen to the sound of a dragon burning the town. What you become is up to you.

# Your first hour
* Choose your race in the character creator. It sets your starting skills, a few lifelong gifts and one greater power.
* Walk down the road to ruined Helgen, find a survivor, and carry the warning to Riverwood.
* Carry word of the dragon to the Jarl of Whiterun. The main quest, The Dragonborn, starts here.
---
# How NirnCraft differs from Minecraft
* You get better at what you do. Swing a sword and One-Handed rises; mine ore and Mining rises.
* You can't dig the land at first. Ore veins and trees are fair game, but soil needs the Mining perk Excavator (Mining 10), stone needs Stonebreaker (30) and the deepest rock Deep Delver (75). Blocks you placed yourself always come back.
* Health regenerates slowly and almost stops in a fight. Eat, drink potions or cast healing spells.
---
# Where to look next
* {key:key.nirncraft.hub} opens the menu hub: Skills, Items, Magic and Map.
* {key:key.nirncraft.journal} opens your journal: quests, factions, party and stats.
* {key:key.nirncraft.map} opens the map of Tamriel.
* Small hints appear in the top-left corner the first time you try something new.

Lost this book? Type /handbook to read it anyway.
guide.nirncraft.chapter.controls.text:
These are your current keys. Change them in Options, Controls, Key Binds, under NirnCraft.

# Menus
* {key:key.inventory}: inventory
* {key:key.nirncraft.hub}: menu hub
* {key:key.nirncraft.skills}: skills and perks
* {key:key.nirncraft.journal}: journal and party
* {key:key.nirncraft.magic_menu}: magic and shouts
* {key:key.nirncraft.map}: map and fast travel
* {key:key.nirncraft.reputation}: reputation
* {key:key.nirncraft.wait}: wait
---
# In the world
* {key:key.nirncraft.interact}: talk, loot, pick up, use
* {key:key.attack}: attack, or cast your right-hand spell. Hold it for a power attack.
* {key:key.use}: hold to block, or cast your left-hand spell
* {key:key.nirncraft.shout}: shout or use a power. Hold it longer for more words.
* {key:key.nirncraft.favorites}: favorites. Keys 1 to 8 equip favorites 1 to 8.
---
* {key:key.sneak}: sneak
* {key:key.nirncraft.dodge}: dodge roll (needs the Dodge Roll perk)
* {key:key.nirncraft.call_horse}: call your horse
* {key:key.nirncraft.sheathe}: ready or sheathe your weapon
* {key:key.nirncraft.stone_power}: Standing Stone power
* {key:key.playerlist}: player list

# Sneaking actions
* Sneak and use a townsperson to pickpocket them.
* Sneak and use a body to drag it.
---
# Controllers and the Steam Deck
Gamepads work out of the box. The pack sets up Steam button icons, a virtual mouse cursor in menus, and button hints.

# Inside the inventory
* W and S choose an item; A and D change the tab.
* E uses or equips, F adds a favorite, R sorts, X inspects, Q drops.
* The Crafting button opens the plain Minecraft inventory.
guide.nirncraft.chapter.races.text:
Twenty-three peoples can be played. Each starts every skill at 15, with +10 in one skill and +5 in five others, and has one greater power. You can use the power every few minutes (see the HUD timer) with {key:key.nirncraft.shout} once you've equipped it in the magic menu.
---
# The ten of Skyrim
* **Nord**: frost resistance, Battle Cry
* **Imperial**: extra gold, Voice of the Emperor
* **Breton**: magic resistance, Dragonskin
* **Redguard**: poison resistance, Adrenaline Rush
* **High Elf**: extra Magicka, Highborn
* **Wood Elf**: resists poison and disease, Command Animal
* **Dark Elf**: fire resistance, Ancestor's Wrath
* **Orc**: Berserker Rage
* **Khajiit**: claws, soft landings, Night Eye
* **Argonian**: water breathing, resists disease, Histskin
---
# Other peoples of Tamriel
The sea-elf Maormer, the Reachmen, the Ohmes-raht, the Lilmothiit and the Imga.

# From Akavir
The serpent Tsaesci, who climb walls; the tiger-folk Ka Po' Tun; and the monkey-folk Tang Mo.

# The lost races
Atmorans, Falmer, Dwemer, Ayleids and Kothringi.
---
Some races have sub-peoples that change only your looks: Colovian and Nibenese Imperials, Stronghold and Wood Orcs, Suthay-raht and Cathay-raht Khajiit, and Saxhleel, Naga and Agaceph Argonians.

The townsfolk you meet are drawn from the same peoples, in the mix their homeland has.
guide.nirncraft.chapter.skills.text:
There are 29 skills. Each one rises as you use it, from 15 up to 100.

# The Warrior
One-Handed, Two-Handed, Archery, Block, Heavy Armor, Smithing, Unarmed and Polearms.

# The Mage
Destruction, Restoration, Alteration, Conjuration, Illusion, Mysticism and Enchanting.
---
# The Thief
Light Armor, Sneak, Lockpicking, Pickpocket, Speech, Alchemy and Acrobatics.

# The life skills
Mining, Woodcutting, Fishing, Hunting, Athletics, Riding and Cooking.
---
# Leveling up
Every skill increase also counts toward your character level. When you level up, press {key:key.nirncraft.skills}: choose Health, Magicka or Stamina (+10), and you also get a perk point.

# Look to the heavens
The skills screen is a night sky with a constellation for each skill: 255 perks in all. Pick a star and spend a point on it if you meet its requirements.
---
# Other ways to improve
* **Trainers** teach for gold, up to five lessons per level.
* **Skill books** raise a skill the first time you read them.
* **Standing Stones** speed up whole groups of skills.
* **Legendary**: a skill at 100 can be reset to 15 to get its perks back and grow it again.
guide.nirncraft.chapter.magic.text:
# Spells
There are 115 spells in six schools: Destruction, Restoration, Alteration, Conjuration, Illusion and Mysticism. They come in five tiers, from Novice to Master. Learn a spell by reading its tome. You'll find tomes in dungeons, and court wizards sell them.
---
# Casting
Equip spells to either hand in the magic menu ({key:key.nirncraft.magic_menu}). {key:key.attack} casts the right hand and {key:key.use} the left. Click to cast a fire-and-forget spell, or hold for a concentration spell. A spell trains its school only when it actually does something.
---
# Making magic
* **Spellmaking Altar**: combine up to four effects you know into a spell of your own.
* **Staff Enchanter**: bind a spell into a staff with a filled soul gem.
* **Arcane Enchanter**: break down an enchanted item to learn its enchantment, then put that enchantment on your own gear.
---
# The Thu'um
There are 26 shouts, each with three Words of Power. Word Walls in old Nordic ruins teach a word. Each dragon soul you absorb unlocks one word you've learned.

Hold {key:key.nirncraft.shout} to shout: the longer you hold it, the more words you use. Each shout must recharge before you can use it again.
---
# Dragons
Dragons circle, breathe fire or frost, and land to bite. Everyone close by absorbs a slain dragon's soul. Dragonrend forces a dragon to the ground.

# Standing Stones
There are thirteen guardian stones across Skyrim. Touch one to take its blessing. Only one blessing is active at a time.
guide.nirncraft.chapter.combat.text:
# Weapons
Daggers, swords, war axes and maces train One-Handed. Greatswords, battleaxes and warhammers train Two-Handed. Spears, halberds and glaives train Polearms, and bows and crossbows train Archery. Each family has its own perks: axes make enemies bleed, maces break through armor, and swords score critical hits.
---
# Power attacks
Hold {key:key.attack}, or attack while sprinting. A power attack costs Stamina, hits for 1.5 times the damage (1.75 with two hands) and staggers the target.

# Blocking
Hold {key:key.use} to block with your weapon or shield. Blocking costs Stamina. A shield blocks far more than a blade.
---
# Sneak attacks
Strike a target that hasn't noticed you: three times the damage with one-handed weapons, and twice with bows. Perks raise this, up to fifteen times with a dagger.

# Armor
Heavy and Light Armor protect you better as the skill rises. Heavy armor slows you down until you learn Conditioning.
---
# Gear
There are 48 armor sets and nearly two hundred weapons, from Iron to Daedric and Dragonbone, plus the arms of every province. Temper them at a grindstone or workbench, from Fine up to Legendary.

# Enemies grow with you
Creatures and bandits scale to your level and take grander titles as they do.
guide.nirncraft.chapter.stealth.text:
# Sneaking
Hold {key:key.sneak} to sneak. The eye above your crosshair opens as people grow aware of you. Darkness, skill and light armor help you stay hidden. Heavy armor makes you easier to spot. Anyone you've hit recently knows where you are.
---
# Lockpicking
Some chests and doors are locked, from Novice to Master. Move the pick with the mouse and turn the lock with A or D. Turn it too hard in the wrong place and the pick breaks.

# Pickpocketing
Sneak up behind someone and use them while you sneak. Each item shows your chance of taking it unseen.
---
# Crime
A crime counts only if someone sees it. Your bounty is kept separately in each hold.
* Trespass 5, pickpocketing 25, assault 40, murder 1000
* Theft: half the stolen goods' value

Stolen goods are marked. Only fences will buy them.
---
# Guards
A guard will stop you. You can pay the bounty, go to jail, talk your way out, or bribe them (this needs a perk). If you resist, you fight. With a bounty of 1000 or more, guards attack on sight.

In jail, sleeping in your cell bed serves your sentence. When you're released, you lose your stolen goods and some skill progress.
guide.nirncraft.chapter.economy.text:
# Septims
Coins go straight into your purse and weigh nothing. Type /gold to see your balance, /pay to give coins to another player, and /withdraw to turn coins back into items.

# Trade
Merchants have their own goods and gold, and they restock every two days. Your Speech skill and perks set your prices.
---
# Making money
Quests, bounties and faction contracts; selling loot, ore, pelts, firewood and fish; and the things you smith, brew and enchant.

# Crafting
* **Forge, smelter, tanning rack**: weapons and armor
* **Grindstone, workbench**: tempering
* **Alchemy lab**: potions. Each ingredient has four effects, which you learn by eating it or brewing with it.
* **Cooking pot**: meals
---
# Houses
Five cities have a house for sale: Breezehome in Whiterun (5,000), Honeyside in Riften and Vlindrel Hall in Markarth (8,000 each), Hjerim in Windhelm (12,000) and Proudspire Manor in Solitude (25,000). Ask the Jarl or the steward. Furnishings cost extra.
---
# Homesteads
Buy land at Lakeview, Windstad or Heljarchen (5,000), or stake a claim of your own. Build your home at a drafting table: a small house, then a main hall, wings, a cellar, a garden, an animal pen and a workshop. You can hire a steward to look after it.

# Carry weight
You can carry 300, plus more for each Stamina increase. Carry more than that and you slow down and can't sprint or fast travel.
guide.nirncraft.chapter.survival.text:
Survival Mode is on by default. Small meters above your health bar track three needs.

# Hunger
You go from Peckish to Starving, and hunger eats into your Stamina. Eat cooked meals: the cook's skill makes them better.

# Fatigue
You go from Tired to Debilitated, and fatigue drains your Magicka. Sleep in a bed or at an inn to become Well Rested. A bedroll or tent only leaves you Rested.
---
# Cold
You go from Chilly to Numb, and cold lowers your health. Fur, hide and Nordic gear keep you warm, and so do hoods and cloaks. Fires, forges, shelter and hot stew warm you. Cold water can kill. Nords feel the cold less.

Operators can turn Survival Mode off with /gamerule nirncraft:survival_mode false.
---
# Camping
Carry a bedroll (it never sets your respawn point), a hide tent and a campfire kit.

# Fishing
There are 52 kinds of fish. What bites depends on the water, the region, the hour, the weather and the depth. Look for jumping fish. When one bites, reel in while the marker crosses the gold zone.
---
# Death
What you carried stays on your body where you fell. It is marked on the map and compass, and you and your party can loot it.

# Disease
Creatures carry ten diseases. Cure them with a potion, by praying at a shrine, or by paying a priest.
guide.nirncraft.chapter.factions.text:
# Joinable factions
The Companions, the College of Winterhold, the Thieves Guild, the Dark Brotherhood, the Imperial Legion, the Stormcloaks and the Bards College. Each has its own ranks, trials and contracts.
---
# Quests
There are 98 story quests: the main quest, The Dragonborn; each faction's storyline; the Civil War; Dawnguard; the Daedric Princes; Solstheim; and the other provinces. On top of these come favors for townsfolk, Jarls' bounties and legendary hunts.

Your journal ({key:key.nirncraft.journal}) lists them. Track a quest to see it on your compass.
---
# People
Townsfolk keep daily routines and remember how you treat them. Do them favors and they come to like you. Friends can become followers, and with an Amulet of Mara you can marry.

# Reputation
{key:key.nirncraft.reputation} shows where you stand with twelve factions, from Hated to Revered. Factions that hate you send killers after you.
guide.nirncraft.chapter.world.text:
The whole continent of Tamriel lies at full scale. One block is about a meter, and Skyrim alone is some six thousand blocks across. Whiterun stands at the center of the map.
---
# The provinces
Skyrim's nine holds and Solstheim; then Cyrodiil, Morrowind, High Rock, Hammerfell, Black Marsh, Elsweyr, Valenwood and the Summerset Isles. Each has its own lands, peoples, towns, ruins and music. Danger grows the farther you go from Whiterun.
---
# Beyond the sea
Atmora lies to the north, Akavir to the east, Yokuda to the west, and Pyandonea and Thras to the south-west. Past them are endless uncharted lands.

# Places
More than six hundred named places: cities, towns, barrows, forts, Dwemer ruins, Standing Stones, Word Walls, dragon mounds and shrines. Each one you find goes on your map.
---
# Travel
* **Fast travel**: open the map ({key:key.nirncraft.map}) and pick a place you've discovered. You can't fast travel in combat or while carrying too much.
* **Carriages** wait outside the cities. They go to any city in their province, and to cities you've discovered in other provinces.
* **Horses** are sold at stables, and wild ones can be tamed. Call your horse with {key:key.nirncraft.call_horse}.
* **Silt striders** carry you between Vvardenfell's towns.
---
# Roads
Roads link the settlements, with signposts and lanterns. Caravans, travelers and patrols use them, and so do bandits.

# Other realms
The Nether is Oblivion, and the End is Sovngarde.
guide.nirncraft.chapter.multiplayer.text:
# Hosting from your own PC
Essential is part of the pack, so nobody has to forward ports.
* Everyone installs the same NirnCraft instance and adds each other as friends in the Essential menu.
* The host opens their world and chooses Host World or Invite Friends from the Essential menu.
* Friends accept the invite and join.
---
# Parties
Create a party in your journal ({key:key.nirncraft.journal}), or with /party create and /party invite. Party members share quests and rewards, show on the map and compass, and can fast travel to each other. When you join a world, you're offered a trip to your party leader.
---
# Sharing the world
* To wait or sleep, everyone online must agree.
* Each player gets their own loot from every dungeon chest.
* Your party can loot your body if you fall.
* Attacking another player counts as a crime.

A dedicated server works the same way. docs/INSTALL.md in the NirnCraft repository explains how to set one up.
guide.nirncraft.hint.welcome: Welcome to Skyrim. Your **Traveler's Handbook** is in your pack. Hold it and press {key:key.use} to read it, or type /handbook.
guide.nirncraft.hint.menus: Press {key:key.nirncraft.hub} for the menu hub: Skills, Items, Magic and Map. {key:key.nirncraft.journal} opens your journal.
guide.nirncraft.hint.sneak: You are sneaking. The eye above your crosshair shows how aware others are of you. Strike an unaware foe for a sneak attack.
guide.nirncraft.hint.combat: Hold {key:key.attack} for a power attack and {key:key.use} to block. Both use Stamina.
guide.nirncraft.hint.low_health: Your health is low. Health barely recovers in a fight: eat, drink a potion or cast a healing spell. {key:key.nirncraft.favorites} opens your favorites.
guide.nirncraft.hint.lockpick: Move the pick with the mouse and turn the lock with A or D. If the lock resists, stop before the pick breaks.
guide.nirncraft.hint.pickpocket: Each item shows your chance of taking it unseen. If you're caught, you get a bounty.
guide.nirncraft.hint.word_wall: You learned a Word of Power. Unlock it with a dragon soul in the magic menu ({key:key.nirncraft.magic_menu}), then hold {key:key.nirncraft.shout} to shout.
guide.nirncraft.hint.dragon_soul: You absorbed a dragon soul. Spend it in the magic menu ({key:key.nirncraft.magic_menu}) to unlock a Word of Power.
guide.nirncraft.hint.magic: Equip spells to your hands in the magic menu ({key:key.nirncraft.magic_menu}). {key:key.attack} casts the right hand and {key:key.use} the left.
guide.nirncraft.hint.level_up: You can level up. Press {key:key.nirncraft.skills} to raise Health, Magicka or Stamina and spend your perk points.
guide.nirncraft.hint.cold: You're getting cold. Wear warm clothing, find shelter, or stand by a fire. Cold water is deadly.
guide.nirncraft.hint.hunger: You're getting hungry, and it's sapping your Stamina. Eat a meal. Cooked food does the most good.
guide.nirncraft.hint.fatigue: You're tired, and it's draining your Magicka. Sleep in a bed or at an inn to become Well Rested.
guide.nirncraft.hint.fishing: When a fish bites, press {key:key.use} to reel in while the marker is inside the gold zone. Different waters, hours and weather bring different fish.
guide.nirncraft.hint.discovery: You discovered a location. Open the map ({key:key.nirncraft.map}) to fast travel back to it later.
guide.nirncraft.hint.bounty: You have a bounty in this hold. Guards will confront you: pay, go to jail, or talk your way out.
guide.nirncraft.hint.overencumbered: You're carrying too much. You can't sprint or fast travel until you drop or sell something.
guide.nirncraft.hint.horse: Horses are fast but can't fight for you. Call yours with {key:key.nirncraft.call_horse}. Riding trains the Riding skill.
guide.nirncraft.hint.oblivion: This is Oblivion, the realm of the Daedra. Tread carefully.
guide.nirncraft.hint.dragon: A dragon! Hit it with arrows and spells while it flies. Strike hard when it lands. Its soul is yours if it dies near you.
nirncraft.guide.arrive.whiterun: Golden tundra grass bends before the wind where Dragonsreach crowns the plains of Whiterun Hold.
nirncraft.guide.rumour.whiterun: Jarl Balgruuf seeks word of the dragon attack at Helgen, and the Companions of Jorrvaskr are testing new blood.
nirncraft.guide.arrive.falkreath: Mist clings to the dark pines and mossy headstones of Falkreath Hold, where every barrow keeps a restless memory.
nirncraft.guide.rumour.falkreath: Travellers whisper of a talking dog on the road outside Falkreath and bandits fortifying the pine-shadowed passes.
nirncraft.guide.arrive.the_rift: Amber birch leaves drift across the lakes and high ridges of the Rift under an eternal autumn sky.
nirncraft.guide.rumour.the_rift: Brynjolf in Riften's marketplace is looking for nimble hands, while the Dawnguard muster at Fort Dawnguard to the east.
nirncraft.guide.arrive.eastmarch: Steam rises from sulfur pools where ancient Nordic stones meet the snow-swept marches of Windhelm.
nirncraft.guide.rumour.eastmarch: Ulfric Stormcloak gathers his banners in the Palace of the Kings, and townsfolk speak of a boy performing the Black Sacrament.
nirncraft.guide.arrive.the_pale: Bitter gales off the Sea of Ghosts scour the white plains and lonely watchtowers of the Pale.
nirncraft.guide.rumour.the_pale: The people of Dawnstar cannot sleep for waking nightmares, and a priest of Mara at Nightcaller Temple seeks aid.
nirncraft.guide.arrive.winterhold: Broken cliffs of ice and stone stand defiant above the freezing surf where the Great Collapse claimed old Winterhold.
nirncraft.guide.rumour.winterhold: The College of Winterhold still welcomes mages across its perilous bridge, investigating an ancient orb buried in Saarthal.
nirncraft.guide.arrive.hjaalmarch: Cold fog coils over the black reed-beds and sunken barrows of Hjaalmarch's haunted salt marshes.
nirncraft.guide.rumour.hjaalmarch: A burned house in Morthal has the Jarl on edge, and dark shapes move among the marsh-lights after sundown.
nirncraft.guide.arrive.haafingar: High upon its great stone arch above the Karth estuary, Solitude watches the ships of the Empire come and go.
nirncraft.guide.rumour.haafingar: General Tullius commands the Legion from Castle Dour, while the Bards College prepares for the burning of King Olaf's effigy.
nirncraft.guide.arrive.the_reach: Sheer crags of silver-veined stone plunge into roaring cataracts where Dwemer brass gleams in the Reach.
nirncraft.guide.rumour.the_reach: Forsworn rebels strike the silver caravans outside Markarth, and vigilant eyes watch an abandoned house in the lower keep.
nirncraft.guide.arrive.alikr_desert: Endless red dunes shimmer beneath a relentless sun from Sentinel's domes to the buried halls of the Alik'r.
nirncraft.guide.rumour.alikr_desert: Ash'abah nomads warn that risen Ra Gada dead stir in the desert tombs outside Sentinel.
nirncraft.guide.arrive.bangkorai: Craggy passes guard the borderlands of Bangkorai where northern pines give way to sun-baked canyon stone.
nirncraft.guide.rumour.bangkorai: Mercenary companies along the Bangkorai Garrison road are hiring blades to hold the canyon gates.
nirncraft.guide.arrive.craglorn: Red mesas and fallen star-stones scar the high badlands of Craglorn beneath troubled constellations.
nirncraft.guide.rumour.craglorn: Scholars in Elinhir offer heavy coin to anyone brave enough to enter the Star-Gazer citadels.
nirncraft.guide.arrive.dragontail: Wind-carved peaks and dry gullies rise along the Dragontail range between Hammerfell and the northern holds.
nirncraft.guide.rumour.dragontail: Caravan masters in Rihad post bounties on mountain raiders blocking the Dragontail passes.
nirncraft.guide.arrive.hews_bane: Lantern-lit coves and limestone arches shelter the corsair harbors of Hew's Bane.
nirncraft.guide.rumour.hews_bane: Merchant princes in Taneth whisper of sunken treasure and rival syndicates along Abah's Landing.
nirncraft.guide.arrive.stros_mkai: Warm trade winds carry the scent of salt and brassworks across the island port of Stros M'Kai.
nirncraft.guide.rumour.stros_mkai: Dockmasters on Stros M'Kai seek crews to clear Dwemer automatons from the headland ruins.
nirncraft.guide.arrive.glenumbra: Ancientstanding stones and rain-washed moors roll westward toward the proud spires of Daggerfall.
nirncraft.guide.rumour.glenumbra: Wyrd sisters on the Glenumbra moors warn of Bloodthorn cultists defiling the ancient barrows.
nirncraft.guide.arrive.rivenspire: Jagged slate ridges and brooding keeps cast long shadows across the windswept valleys of Rivenspire.
nirncraft.guide.rumour.rivenspire: Noble houses in Shornhelm seek sellswords to lift the crimson curse gripping the northern crags.
nirncraft.guide.arrive.stormhaven: Salt spray from the Iliac Bay mists the Pennant-hung watchtowers and green hills of Stormhaven.
nirncraft.guide.rumour.stormhaven: Knights of the Flame are recruiting travellers to put an end to nightmares haunting the abbey roads.
nirncraft.guide.arrive.bjoulsae: Horsemen and river-barges follow the winding Bjoulsae from grassy downs to busy market fords.
nirncraft.guide.rumour.bjoulsae: River wardens in Evermor offer bounties on Reach raiders crossing the Bjoulsae fords.
nirncraft.guide.arrive.wayrest: Merchant galleons crowd the estuary beneath the grand counting-houses and gardens of Wayrest.
nirncraft.guide.rumour.wayrest: Court intrigues and corsair blockades have Wayrest's guildhalls posting urgent contracts.
nirncraft.guide.arrive.wrothgar: Iron-gray peaks and smoking clan-forges rise over the snowbound strongholds of Wrothgar.
nirncraft.guide.rumour.wrothgar: Forge-mothers in Orsinium call for warriors to reclaim ancient clan relics from the Winterborn.
nirncraft.guide.arrive.jerall_mountains: Snow-laden passes along the Jerall crest look down upon Bruma, Cloud Ruler Temple, and the northern marches of Cyrodiil.
nirncraft.guide.rumour.jerall_mountains: Caravanners in Bruma complain of double Pale Pass tolls between Countess Carvain's gate-reeves and the Legion, while smugglers work Fort Dragonclaw.
nirncraft.guide.arrive.colovian_highland: Oak-crowned hills and stone sheep-estates stand watch over Chorrol and the proud Colovian West.
nirncraft.guide.rumour.colovian_highland: The Fighters Guild in Chorrol is losing highland wool-contracts to cut-rate brokers while baited goblin raids strike the estates.
nirncraft.guide.arrive.heartlands: Across the sparkling waters of Lake Rumare, White-Gold Tower gleams above the six wards and ancient underworks of the Imperial City.
nirncraft.guide.rumour.heartlands: Imperial Watch investigators seek the master forger beneath the capital who is selling identical Septim pedigrees to rival Elder Council blocs.
nirncraft.guide.arrive.great_forest: Sunlight filters through ancient oaks and white Ayleid arches between Weye, Weynon Priory, and the deep glades of the Great Forest.
nirncraft.guide.rumour.great_forest: Three Arcane University scholars vanished near Fort Nikel and Vlastarus after receiving invitations to the midnight Forest Lectures.
nirncraft.guide.arrive.nibenay_basin: Willow-lined streams and painted bridges wind beneath the eastern foothills of Cheydinhal and the Nibenay Basin.
nirncraft.guide.rumour.nibenay_basin: A scuttled silk-barge in Cheydinhal's Corbolo canal lock has Dunmer bankers and old Nibenese merchants on the brink of a charter war.
nirncraft.guide.arrive.west_weald: Rolling vineyards and limestone pastures stretch between the high walls of Skingrad and the Valenwood border.
nirncraft.guide.rumour.west_weald: Sabotaged wine-wains and counterfeit wax seals have reignited the Surilie-Tamika feud outside Skingrad before the autumn Wine Harvest.
nirncraft.guide.arrive.gold_coast: Warm sea breezes stir the olive groves of Anvil and the rising scaffolding of Kvatch along the Abecean shore.
nirncraft.guide.rumour.gold_coast: Masonry shipments for Kvatch's rebuild are vanishing along the Gold Road while false beacon lights lure ships onto the reefs north of Anvil.
nirncraft.guide.arrive.nibenay_valley: River mists drift past the Lucky Old Lady's plaza and bustling timber docks of Bravil along the lower Niben.
nirncraft.guide.rumour.nibenay_valley: Wish-coins in Bravil's fountain are being swapped for skooma-barge brass tokens stamped in the harbour clerk's own office.
nirncraft.guide.arrive.blackwood: Cypress roots and lantern-lit causeways wind through the dark border-marshes of Leyawiin and Blackwood.
nirncraft.guide.rumour.blackwood: Ampoules of stolen Hist sap have washed into Leyawiin's reed-canals, drawing An-Xileel scouts to the Niben mouth.
nirncraft.guide.arrive.stonefalls: Volcanic steam vents and basalt sea-walls frame the Imperial port of Ebonheart and the ancient mainland towns of Stonefalls.
nirncraft.guide.rumour.stonefalls: Duplicate Inner Sea customs manifests have surfaced between Ebonheart, Davon's Watch, and Kragenmoor while cargo vanishes into Ash Mountain.
nirncraft.guide.arrive.deshaan: Fertile saltrice plains and sacred avenues lead toward the ringed capital of Mournhold and the southern marshes of Tear.
nirncraft.guide.rumour.deshaan: Forged Temple quarantine writs are being used to impound caravan warehouses in Mournhold while Dwemer bells toll beneath Bamz-Amschend.
nirncraft.guide.arrive.molag_amur: White ossuary walls rise above the eastern coast at Necrom while ash-rivers and basalt crags stretch inland across Molag Amur.
nirncraft.guide.rumour.molag_amur: Corpse-ships wait at Zaappi Docks after grave-brokers stole the ancestral Ossuary Roll from Necrom's lower catacombs.
nirncraft.guide.arrive.telvannis: Giant Emperor Parasol mushrooms tower over the Zafirbel Bay islands of Sadrith Mora, Firewatch, and Port Telvannis.
nirncraft.guide.rumour.telvannis: Council Mouths at Tel Naga are hiring outlanders to prune a rogue Dwemer-grafted spore tower near Tel Dreloth.
nirncraft.guide.arrive.sheogorad: Jagged basalt skerries and cold northern surf surround the Nord-Dunmer fishing port of Dagon Fel and quiet Sanctus Shrine.
nirncraft.guide.rumour.sheogorad: False storm-lanterns on the Sheogorad reefs have been luring cogs onto the rocks near Vas while locals blame the Urshilaku hunters.
nirncraft.guide.arrive.vvardenfell_ashla: Scoured grey ash-plains and wind-carved foyadas surround the giant crab-shell council hall of Skar at Ald'ruhn.
nirncraft.guide.rumour.vvardenfell_ashla: Redoran patrols at Ald'ruhn and Maar Gan have uncovered red-wax Sixth House bells smuggled from Falasmaryon and Kogoruhn.
nirncraft.guide.arrive.grazelands: Golden savannah grass and Telvanni mushroom roots meet the Ashlander tent-rings between Vos, Tel Vos, and Zainab Camp.
nirncraft.guide.rumour.grazelands: A leaking Dwemer blight-conduit between Mudan-Mul Egg Mine and Nchardahrk has fouled the grazing springs outside Vos.
nirncraft.guide.arrive.azuras_coast: Basalt headlands and sea-mists shelter the Buoyant Armiger canton of Molag Mar, Divayth Fyr's tower, and hidden Holamayan.
nirncraft.guide.rumour.azuras_coast: Medical skiffs bound for Tel Fyr and pilgrim boats to Holamayan are being intercepted by rogue factors operating out of Telasero.
nirncraft.guide.arrive.west_gash: Terraced Hlaalu stone bridges span the Odai River at Balmora below the ebony mines of Caldera and Moonmoth Legion Fort.
nirncraft.guide.rumour.west_gash: Every third ebony wain from Caldera Mine is vanishing down the smuggling trail toward Hla Oad and Hlormaren.
nirncraft.guide.arrive.bitter_coast: Bioluminescent fungi and netch-bladder lanterns glow through the mangrove fog around the stilt-village of Gnaar Mok.
nirncraft.guide.rumour.bitter_coast: An Imperial revenue cutter vanished off Khartag Point after bribed excise clerks lured the crew into the sea-caves of Nammu.
nirncraft.guide.arrive.ascadian_isles: Placid lagoons and terraced cantons rise at Vivec City above the plantations and pilgrim roads of the Ascadian Isles.
nirncraft.guide.rumour.ascadian_isles: Twin-lantern chalk marks in Vivec's underworks point to an abolitionist safe-route hunted by Dren Plantation mercenaries.
nirncraft.guide.arrive.red_mountain: The glowing blue ancestor-wall of the Ghostfence encircles the blighted volcanic slopes of Red Mountain above Ghostgate.
nirncraft.guide.rumour.red_mountain: Harmonic Sixth House bells inside Nchuleft and Red Mountain's caldera have cracked three bone-pylons along the Ghostfence.
nirncraft.guide.arrive.solstheim: Ash-drifts from Red Mountain cloak Raven Rock and Tel Mithryn in the south while snow-pines shelter the Skaal in the north.
nirncraft.guide.rumour.solstheim: Ash-spawn raids from Fort Frostmoth and a strange sleep-chant around the All-Maker Stones have put Raven Rock and Skaal Village on alert.
nirncraft.guide.arrive.shadowfen: Hanging moss, rusted shackle-cairns, and sunken Xanmeer steps rise from the mist-shrouded waters of Shadowfen around Thorn.
nirncraft.guide.rumour.shadowfen: Chain-Breaker wardens in Thorn and Ten-Maur-Wolk warn that Dres slaver remnants are tampering with the broken-shackle cairns.
nirncraft.guide.arrive.stormhold: Barsaebic Ayleid stonework and Argonian mud-domes mingle along the border causeways of Stormhold.
nirncraft.guide.rumour.stormhold: Tree-Minders and caravan factors in Stormhold dispute tampered toll-seals discovered near the Barsaebic undercity.
nirncraft.guide.arrive.helstrom: Dense root-tangles and amber-lit channels guard the sacred Hist sanctuary at the heart of Helstrom.
nirncraft.guide.rumour.helstrom: Root-Heart elders in Helstrom seek trustworthy outsiders to investigate disturbed sap-stones along the inner causeway.
nirncraft.guide.arrive.gideon: Walled levees, bog-rice paddies, and weathered Kothringi pillars mark the western marshlands of Gideon.
nirncraft.guide.rumour.gideon: Lukiul magistrates and An-Xileel scouts in Gideon clash over missing levee tallies at the old governor's vaults.
nirncraft.guide.arrive.lilmoth: Salt-tides and river silt meet among the smuggling wharves and sunken quarantine shrines of Lilmoth.
nirncraft.guide.rumour.lilmoth: Harbour syndicates in Lilmoth and Blackrose accuse customhouse clerks of diverting spice barges into the drowned hulks.
nirncraft.guide.arrive.murkmire: Vibrant swamp-blooms, stilt-villages, and towering calendar Xanmeers rise from the southern depths of Murkmire.
nirncraft.guide.rumour.murkmire: Bright-Throat and Dead-Water elders in Murkmire seek aid after a Sithis calendar-tablet was pried from the grand Xanmeer.
nirncraft.guide.arrive.anequina: Sun-bleached badlands, caravan wheels, and wind-scoured mesas stretch across the northern kingdom of Anequina from Riverhold to Dune.
nirncraft.guide.rumour.anequina: Well-clan wardens in Riverhold and Dune investigate tampered cistern-tallies and Renrijra canyon ambushes.
nirncraft.guide.arrive.rimmen: Imperial-era aqueducts and palace terraces overlook the sugar-cane fields and alabaster quarries of Rimmen.
nirncraft.guide.rumour.rimmen: Master artisans and Hakoshae mask-makers in Rimmen warn of stolen ancestral seals inside the old necropolis.
nirncraft.guide.arrive.torval: Incense and bronze moon-bells echo from the cedar sanctuaries of Torval where the Mane holds court.
nirncraft.guide.rumour.torval: Priests in Torval's temple quarter seek aid after a Two-Moons procession seal vanished on the road to Shabaae Mine.
nirncraft.guide.arrive.pellitine: Warm monsoon rains nourish the lush Tenmar jungles, boil-houses, and spice groves of southern Pellitine around Corinthe.
nirncraft.guide.rumour.pellitine: Cane-cutters and planter houses in Corinthe are on edge over contested debt-tallies at the Halls of Colossus.
nirncraft.guide.arrive.senchal: Colorful silk sails and gilded pagoda roofs gleam above the southern harbour wards of Senchal.
nirncraft.guide.rumour.senchal: Harbour wardens in Senchal track counterfeit customs stamps moving between the Lower Sweet docks and the smuggler coves.
nirncraft.guide.arrive.malabal_tor: Canopies so thick they swallow the noon sun shelter the migratory tree-boughs of Silvenar and Malabal Tor.
nirncraft.guide.rumour.malabal_tor: Envoys at Silvenar and Velyn Harbor seek scouts to settle a Green Pact dispute near the Tomb of the Apostates.
nirncraft.guide.arrive.reapers_march: Golden savannas and ancient Khajiiti temples meet the northern border-woods of Arenthia and Rawl'kha in Reaper's March.
nirncraft.guide.rumour.reapers_march: Truce-elders in Arenthia and Rawl'kha investigate a missing Bone-Truce relic along the northern grain road.
nirncraft.guide.arrive.grahtwood: Colossal graht-oaks wide as citadels lift the bough-halls of Elden Root high above the southern delta.
nirncraft.guide.rumour.grahtwood: Spinners and sap-tappers at Elden Root report disturbed Ayleid vaults beneath the great tree's roots.
nirncraft.guide.arrive.greenshade: Crystal springs, root-bridges, and flower-carpeted glades wind toward Woodhearth and the western shores of Greenshade.
nirncraft.guide.rumour.greenshade: Spinners in Woodhearth and Greenheart warn of Maormer landing parties disturbing the Wilderking's hollow.
nirncraft.guide.arrive.summerset_isle: Alabaster towers and prismatic glass spires catch the sea-light above the terraced gardens of Alinor and Cloudrest.
nirncraft.guide.rumour.summerset_isle: Sapiarchs and Kinlord stewards in Alinor quietly investigate missing lineage-tallies and abyssal geyser tremors.
nirncraft.guide.arrive.auridon: Cherry-blossom groves and white marble sanctuaries line the eastern shores of Firsthold and Skywatch on Auridon.
nirncraft.guide.rumour.auridon: High Elf marines in Firsthold and Skywatch hunt Veiled Heritance conspirators tampering with coastal beacons.
nirncraft.guide.arrive.artaeum: Beyond the reach of ordinary charts, the timeless lotus orchards and Ceporah spires of Artaeum drift in quiet serenity.
nirncraft.guide.rumour.artaeum: Ritemasters at the Grand Psijic Villa ask trusted travellers to stabilise time-vault seals around Ceporah Tower.
nirncraft.guide.arrive.ice_waste: Howling catabatic blizzards and blue glacier walls stretch endlessly across the Ice Waste of old Atmora above Kjolvik.
nirncraft.guide.rumour.ice_waste: Windhelm charter crews at Kjolvik Anchorage seek aid recovering stalhrim tallies from the Frozen Dragon Mound.
nirncraft.guide.arrive.frozen_forest: Rime-coated petrified pines stand in stone-still silence above the ancient stone slipways of Jylkurfyk in Atmora.
nirncraft.guide.rumour.frozen_forest: Chroniclers at Jylkurfyk warn that a frost-bound barrow-king is stirring inside the ice-tombs.
nirncraft.guide.arrive.tsaesci: Stepped red-lacquer canals and bamboo mists guard the coiled valleys of Tsaesci around the Black Lacquer Pagoda.
nirncraft.guide.rumour.tsaesci: Tally-seal custodians at the Black Lacquer Pagoda investigate a missing Imperial eagle-standard from the Ionith ruins.
nirncraft.guide.arrive.kamal: Volcanic ice-peaks and thaw-flooded fjords mark the harsh northern domain of Kamal around Ada'Soom's Gate.
nirncraft.guide.rumour.kamal: Pass-watch wardens at Ada'Soom's Gate offer high bounties to halt a Winter Host thaw-vanguard descending from the glaciers.
nirncraft.guide.arrive.tang_mo: Mist-wreathed karst spires and cloud-bamboo suspension bridges rise above Tang Mo Harbor Village.
nirncraft.guide.rumour.tang_mo: Island ranger clans at Tang Mo Harbor Village seek allies after raiders cut the signal ropes at Thousand Monkey Tree.
nirncraft.guide.arrive.ka_po_tun: Golden grass steppes and monumental tiger-carved gates blaze under the eastern sun around Tosh Raka's Palace.
nirncraft.guide.rumour.ka_po_tun: Tiger-Monk retainers at Tosh Raka's Palace test travellers who can recover the stolen bronze sanctuary seals.
nirncraft.guide.arrive.yokudan_desert: Sheared red mesas and star-aligned sword-temples remain above the waves around the Hall of the Ansei in Yokuda.
nirncraft.guide.rumour.yokudan_desert: Ankh-keepers at the Hall of the Ansei seek help recovering stolen star-charts from Hunding's Dojo.
nirncraft.guide.arrive.sunken_isles: Turquoise ruin-lagoons and wave-washed causeways mark the outer Sunken Isles of lost Yokuda.
nirncraft.guide.rumour.sunken_isles: Salvage wardens on the Isle of the Drowned Ansei warn of plunderers breaking the seals of the sunken royal temple.
nirncraft.guide.arrive.maormer_isles: Warm sea-mist curtains and serpent-prowed docks surround the Pyandonean Fleet Anchorage in the Maormer Isles.
nirncraft.guide.rumour.maormer_isles: Truce-captains at Mistveil Village and the Fleet Anchorage clash with Storm-Caste saboteurs over the black-pearl tallies.
nirncraft.guide.arrive.coral_kingdom: Phosphorescent brine-haze and living coral spires rise from the abyssal caldera of the Coral Kingdom of Thras.
nirncraft.guide.rumour.coral_kingdom: Sandbar contractors near the Coral Tower of Thras warn that unsealed plague-vats are fouling the lagoon exchange.
nirncraft.guide.arrive.blackrose: Dark stone prison-walls and reed-fringed canals rise above the southern marsh approaches to Blackrose and Lilmoth.
nirncraft.guide.rumour.blackrose: Wardens near Blackrose Ruins and Lilmoth report missing customs tallies along the smuggler channels.
nirncraft.guide.arrive.thornmarsh: Percolating mire-pools and raised timber causeways wind toward the border seat of Thorn.
nirncraft.guide.rumour.thornmarsh: Chain-Breaker scouts around Thorn hunt remnant slavers hiding in the sunken Xanmeer vaults.
nirncraft.guide.arrive.archon_coast: Mangrove surf and coral-crusted channels line the eastern Archon shore of Black Marsh.
nirncraft.guide.rumour.archon_coast: Coastal boatmen between Archon and Helstrom speak of altered beacon-stones along the eastern tide-channels.
nirncraft.guide.arrive.argonia_heart: Colossal Hist roots arch over the spore-thick waterways at the impenetrable heart of Argonia.
nirncraft.guide.rumour.argonia_heart: Tree-Minders in the inner marsh guard the sacred sap-naming pools against unauthorised delves.
nirncraft.guide.arrive.khenarthis_roost: Trade-wind palms and temple bells greet ships making landfall along the southern coast of Senchal and Khenarthi's Roost.
nirncraft.guide.rumour.khenarthis_roost: Sailors along the southern anchorage warn of skooma smugglers using false Khenarthi wind-signals.
nirncraft.guide.arrive.rimmen_steppe: Dry steppe grass and white alabaster ridges roll beneath the aqueduct arches of the Rimmen frontier.
nirncraft.guide.rumour.rimmen_steppe: Baandari traders outside Rimmen whisper of customs disputes and tomb-thieves in the quarry undercuts.
nirncraft.guide.arrive.arenthia_vale: Vine-draped Colovian stonework and Bosmer hunting trails converge across the border hills of Arenthia Vale.
nirncraft.guide.rumour.arenthia_vale: Border wardens in Arenthia need scouts to inspect disturbed Bone-Truce markers along the Strid frontier.
nirncraft.guide.arrive.arteum: Beyond the reach of ordinary charts, the timeless lotus orchards and Ceporah spires of Artaeum drift in quiet serenity.
nirncraft.guide.rumour.arteum: Ritemasters at the Grand Psijic Villa ask trusted travellers to stabilise time-vault seals around Ceporah Tower.
nirncraft.guide.arrive.atmora_coast: Pack-ice leads and frozen shingle beaches mark the perilous southern landing coast of old Atmora.
nirncraft.guide.rumour.atmora_coast: Charter crews at Kjolvik watch the summer ice-leads and seek delvers for the entombed great-halls.
nirncraft.guide.arrive.jylkurfyk: Petrified rime-woods and ancient stone ship-slips frame the ruined Atmoran port of Jylkurfyk.
nirncraft.guide.rumour.jylkurfyk: Expedition chroniclers at Jylkurfyk seek guards to inspect disturbed dragon-totem seals in the great barrow.
nirncraft.guide.arrive.yokuda_remnant: Sun-baked red mesas and Ansei star-obelisks stand above the sea on the remnant islands of Yokuda.
nirncraft.guide.rumour.yokuda_remnant: Ansei keepers at New Tava and the Hall of the Ansei guard the fault-vaults against unlicensed treasure-seekers.
nirncraft.guide.arrive.ra_gada_shoals: Submerged marble colonnades and turquoise shoals mark where the Ra Gada fleets last sailed from Yokuda.
nirncraft.guide.rumour.ra_gada_shoals: Salvage divers in the Sunken Isles trade memory-stone rubbings recovered from the drowned orichalc vaults.
nirncraft.guide.arrive.pyandonea: Eternal sea-mist and kelp-draped volcanic reefs shelter the serpent lagoons of Pyandonea.
nirncraft.guide.rumour.pyandonea: Truce-fleet captains at the Pyandonean Anchorage seek discreet hands to quell a Storm-Caste mutiny.
nirncraft.guide.arrive.thras: Bleached and living coral ziggurats ring the abyssal blue holes of the Thrassian archipelago.
nirncraft.guide.rumour.thras: Quarantined factors on the Thras sandbars pay handsomely to contain rogue thrall-reef specimens.
